messages:
rachel: Quick note 1: ran mixed-slice replay for Aegis-9B (int6) vs Nova-7B (int8). Putting numbers and a small canary proposal here for product + ops.

 tom: High level first: significant token-cost win, moderate p99 regression on long tails, small regressions on code formatting slices.

 ishita: Bench highlights (10k replay): avg tokens/request 140, throughput +1.5x, cost/1k tokens Aegis $0.38 vs Nova $0.70, p50 85ms vs 80ms, p99 400ms vs 350ms. Quality: +0.6% composite, -0.4% code-format slice, -0.2% legal-recall.

 leo: Infra observations: int6 kernels stable on H100. Memory footprint down ~9% -> better batching. KV-cache warmups unchanged. We saw occasional queue spikes when mixed large-context requests hit.

 rachel: Proposed canary (short):
```json
{"model":"aegis-9b-int6","canary_hours":36,"start_pct":10,"max_pct":30,"allow_slices":["summaries","faq","small_chat"],"block_slices":["code","contracts","legal"]}
```

 ishita: Rollback triggers (suggested): composite_quality_drop_pct >= 0.5 OR any blocked_slice_drop >= 0.3 OR latency_p99_increase_pct >= 20. Also require manual signoff if we see user-reported formatting regressions.

 tom: Unit-econ quick math for planning (1M req/day @140 tokens avg): tokens/day = 140M. Cost/day Aegis = (140M / 1k) * $0.38 = ~$53.2k. Cost/day Nova = (140M / 1k) * $0.70 = ~$98k. Savings ~= $44.8k/day (~46%).

 leo: Ops plan: start 10% on allow_slices for 24h with verbose traces, token-level cost logging, and daily automated slice-eval. If stable, move to 25% for next 12h then 30% max. We'll add a fallback route: if model_confidence < 0.6 on code/legal requests, route to Nova.

 ishita: Product note: prefer 10% -> 25% path but require that code-format slice shows <0.1% regression in live traffic before any traffic to code funnels. Also prepare opt-in toggle for customers who want lower-cost defaults.

 rachel: Decision: deploy canary now at 10% for 24h to allow_slices. Team owners: product=ishita, infra=leo, eval=rachel. Schedule check-in at +12h and +24h.

 ops-bot: Canary initiated (id: c-2026-176555). Routes: summaries, faq, small_chat. Traffic=10%. Monitoring hooks: slice-daily-eval, infra-trace, model-conf-fallback.

 tom: Also capturing a couple of follow-ups: 1) run targeted longform replay (5k long prompts) to stress p99, 2) add small sample QA on code formatting across languages, 3) sanity-check top 50 GTN customers for any regressions.

 rachel: Thanks all 1. Will post results after 12h check. :rocket:
